meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). Uses real Chrome with CDP to bypass anti-automation. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布推文和长文到 X。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post tweets and articles to X.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能用真实 Chrome 浏览器把内容发布到 X（Twitter）：支持文字带图（最多4张）、视频、引用推文，以及 Markdown 长文（需 X Premium）。发帖前默认先预览，确认后才提交。
howto.when: 当你说出“post to X”、“tweet”、“share on X”等发布到 X/Twitter 的指令，或要求把文字、图片、视频、文章发到 X 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这句话发到 X：今天天气真好。
把这张图片配上文字“新品上市”发到 X 上。
say.note: 调用图片发布脚本，先预览再提交。

say.text: 把我写的 article.md 发布成 X 文章。
say.note: 需 Premium 账号，会先预览。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude post content to X (Twitter) using a real Chrome browser: text with images (up to 4), videos, quote tweets, and Markdown long-form articles (requires X Premium). Posts preview by default before submission.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "post to X", "tweet", "share on X", or ask to send text, images, videos, or articles to X.

say_en.text: Post this sentence to X: The weather is nice today.
say_en.note: It will preview first, then confirm.

say_en.text: Post this image with the caption "New product" to X.
say_en.note: Uses image script, previews before submit.

say_en.text: Publish my article.md as an X Article.
